name: Chicken Chile Verde Pressure Cooker

ingredients.name: bone-in skin-on chicken thighs and drumsticks
Serrano peppers, roughly chopped, stems discarded
whole cumin seeds, toasted and ground
loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves, fine stems plus more for garnish
Asian fish sauce, such as Red Boat

instructions.primary_message: Combine chicken, poblano peppers, tomatillos, onion, Anaheim peppers, Serrano peppers, garlic, cumin, and a big pinch of salt in a pressure cooker. Heat over high heat until gently sizzling, then seal pressure cooker, bring to high pressure, and cook for 15 minutes. Release pressure.

Using tongs, transfer chicken pieces to a bowl and set aside. Add cilantro and fish sauce to remaining contents of pressure cooker. Blend with an immersion blender or in a countertop blender and season to taste with salt. Return chicken to sauce, discarding skin and bones and shredding if desired.
Transfer to a serving platter, garnish with chopped cilantro, and serve immediately with tortillas and lime wedges.

schema_metadata.keywords: chicken, chile verde, chili, easy, green chili, low carb, quick, tomatillo

description: This pressure cooker green chili chicken (chile verde) recipe is a fast, easy weeknight meal, loaded with peppers, onions, and tender chicken.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Fresh corn tortillas and lime wedges, for serving

Optional substitutions: Anaheim peppers → Cubanelle peppers; Serrano peppers → jalapeño peppers
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
